text:
maria_cs: FYI — Thalesys (finance) asked for a temporary demo boost next Tue/Wed. They want EU + LATAM capacity + an allowlist so they can run a live customer demo.
maria_cs: Email thread with details: https://email.internal/thalesys-demo (private)
jamal_support: What's the expected qps and duration? IP allowlist or header pinning?
maria_cs: They said ~250 sustained, 350 peak for ~4 hours each day. Would prefer header pin (they rotate IPs). Demo time windows: 2026-04-07 14:00-18:00 UTC and 2026-04-08 14:00-18:00 UTC.
devon_eng: header pinning + soft qps bump sounds fine. We'll route to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1 for latency.
karen_oncall: Heads-up: if we lift QPS we should do a canary route and a hard autotrevert after 48h. Also note renewal flag — they've been slow on procurement, AE asked for help to avoid churn.
maria_cs: tagging AE (cc @jamal_support) — AE wants us to be ready to leave the bump in for 72h if demo converts.
jamal_support: Proposed config:
```
POST /config/overrides
{
  "customer": "thalesys",
  "scope": "route",
  "regions": ["eu-west-1","sa-east-1"],
  "allowlist": {"type":"header","header_name":"x-thalesys-demo","value":"demo-2026"},
  "rate_override": {"qps":350,"burst":600},
  "duration": "72h",
  "autorevert": true
}
```

jamal_support: If infra is ok I'll apply a canary to 10% of traffic for 10m then flip.
devon_eng: OK from infra. Two notes: (1) need to pre-warm KV cache for demo routes; I'll run a warmup job before start. (2) we should pin model variant to v2-small for the demo to cap latency.
maria_cs: please add pre-warm and model pin steps into the runbook. AE will feed once they confirm demo prompts.
karen_oncall: I'll add alert thresholds: 5xx spike >1% and p50 latency >200ms to the demo route. Paging to oncall if triggered.
jamal_support: Applying header-allowlist and route override now to staging canary.
deploy-bot: change-request 1768009876: applying route override for thalesys to staging canary (10%).
deploy-bot: change-success 1768009892: staging canary healthy (10m rollout). No errors.
jamal_support: Rolling to prod 100% now, autorevert scheduled at 72h from now. TTL for allowlist set to 7d.
deploy-bot: change-success 1768009958: prod override applied to eu-west-1, sa-east-1. QA pass.
maria_cs: Thanks team. AE note: Capture this in renewal brief — positive demo readiness + quick ops support reduces churn risk.
karen_oncall: Added incident runbook link: https://playbooks.internal/demo-thalesys-runbook
maria_cs: I'll follow up with Thalesys and confirm header value + DoS safeguards.
jamal_support: Logged ticket CS-1428 with config and timestamps.
maria_cs: closing the thread once AE confirms conversion. :thumbsup:
